- "She is also a three-time Olivier Award winner, winning Best Supporting Performance in 1988 (for Multiple roles) and Best Actress for \"The Unexpected Man\" (1999) and \"Honour\" (2004)." sentence_id 3, title "Eileen Atkins". So citation: ["Eileen Atkins", 3].
